answer: Counterparty diversity can price sybils out of an agent economy. Earnings count only from trades with distinct, unrelated peers, so a farm trading inside its own haven of clones earns nothing. Each identity must wander into the open garden and win k outside partners per epoch. Identities that share partners are merged into one, so n clones need n·k disjoint honest partners, a scarce pool no farm can buy in bulk, and each reused partner links two clones. An honest agent builds its circle once. The weak spot is bribed partners, so a partner loses score when its contacts merge.
